title: Mechanical Design Engineer
summary: A mechanical design engineer turns product ideas into 3D CAD models, 2D drawings and bills of materials that a factory can build. Early-career design engineers work in an R&D or engineering team under a senior designer, doing calculations, applying GD&T (the symbols that define allowed shape and size variation) and fixing designs for manufacturing.
dailyDuties: Model parts and assemblies in SolidWorks, Creo or CATIA
Make 2D drawings with GD&T and release them for review
Prepare and update bills of materials for assemblies
Run design calculations and simple tolerance stack-ups
Discuss manufacturability with production and suppliers
Update designs after review comments and engineering changes

skills.expectation: Build parts and assemblies in SolidWorks, Creo, CATIA or NX
Make 2D manufacturing drawings that follow drafting standards
Apply GD&T symbols correctly on drawings
Choose fits and check a simple tolerance stack-up
Prepare and update the bill of materials for an assembly
Do hand calculations for strength, shafts, bearings and fasteners
Pick materials and processes such as machining, sheet metal or casting
Explain designs to seniors, the shop floor and suppliers
Change designs so they are easier to make and assemble
Run basic stress checks in ANSYS or CAD simulation
Keep design calculations and trackers in Excel
Help investigate field or production issues
